'''G-400''' was a type of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] used by the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]].

==Characteristics==
The G-400 starfighter was a single-seat fighter with two engines. It was equipped with a single [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] and [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] and also utilized a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].<ref name="Star Wars: Starfighter" />

==History==
One G-400 helped the pirate [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] [[Battle of Lok (32 BBY)|take down]] a [[Trade Federation Superfreighter]] over [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Star Wars: Starfighter" /> It apparently proved popular among the Revenants, since it was the most common starfighter in their use [[22 BBY/Legends|ten years later]].<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This starfighter was first used in the video game [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']] and again in its [[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter|sequel]]. It is an NPC wingmate. [[File:Freefall_swsf.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Head-on view of a G-400 starfighter]]

==Appearances==
